scope: Round 14's lattice electrodynamics on the doubly reversed seam. Trapped flux and a matter current compared at matched total energy, over 12 draws at each of two sizes, with gauge-invariant observables only. Classical throughout; lattice units; no norm, detector law or statement about which route BAM uses.

withdrawn_claims.the matter route needs the fibre reversa: Fibre reversal is sufficient, not necessary. Admissible matter data on the time-reversing, fibre-preserving seam, with zero initial sheet charge and zero trapped flux, also develop sheet charge. Only the ordinary handle forbids it.
withdrawn_claims.no first-order interference: Charge conjugation forbids x y Phi and allows x^2 y^2 Phi. The part of the additivity defect odd in the flux is nonzero and quartic in the field. Additivity holds at leading order in matter amplitude.
withdrawn_claims.the flux never moves by more than 1.5 pe: That bound was on medians. Individual histories move by up to 6.3 percent. No history changes sign.

contradicted_predictions.screening_rule: Frozen P8 required the early flux change to match -1/2 g^2 Phi (B_0/|C|) t^2 within 5 % at t = 0.1 for every resolved draw. One replicate draw misses by 6.4 %. The sign rule holds in every resolved draw. The formula is the leading order: its error falls as t^2 and is below 1 % at t = 0.04. The tolerance was mis-set, and so was my first explanation of the miss.
